verdict.rationale: Rollbar ships its own AI agent (Resolve), so letting users plug external MCP servers into it is a fair question. The pack has no evidence that Rollbar or Resolve can act as an MCP client. The documented MCP capability is the opposite role: Rollbar's own stdio MCP server, which external AI tools like Claude or Cursor run. That belongs to a different story and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
